blocks.text:
This notebook includes a home account book that allows you to manage your schedules and expenses in one book.
Uses the patented "Magic Index" function that changes pages open at the position of the index,
Monthly block schedule pages and home account book functions alternately.
Press the red index, only the red page, press the grey index, only the grey page is open, and the white index between red and gray will open.
The Home Accounts Book page uses Midori's popular "Easy Home Account Book".
The MD paper used in this text is resistant to bleeding and bleeding, and continues to pursue a good writing experience.
Product Name: Midori Monthly 2026 Double Schedule B6 Money Teal 22386006 (Starts October 2025)

items: Manage your money and schedules in one book
